# Regression for the armor detection/reader tolerance mismatch: an armored
# file whose header line is indented or carries trailing whitespace must be
# both auto-detected as armored and decrypted. Leading blank lines already
# worked and are kept as the control case.

# Indented header line (leading spaces on the BEGIN line itself).
age -d -i key.txt indented_header.age
cmp stdout plaintext

# Header line with trailing whitespace before its newline.
age -d -i key.txt trailing_ws_header.age
cmp stdout plaintext

# Control case: full blank (whitespace-only) lines before the header.
age -d -i key.txt leading_blank_lines.age
cmp stdout plaintext

-- key.txt --
# created: 2025-12-23T22:21:12+01:00
# public key: age15w9kgvgggmfra4sz6vk39kz4mveuq2sfv5vmcu090y0k2sluepaqv7z2fv
AGE-SECRET-KEY-18J6FVYJE2AFSJ0RPH6M29GMUU62UVRSCNWUJZSGETH6R38Q5AZ3S2DHAZ9
-- plaintext --
